title: Dracula (4K Restoration)

locale.title: Dracula 4k Restoration
locale.synopsis: A landmark in Gothic horror, Dracula cemented Hammer Films' reputation as the leading force in modern horror cinema and introduced audiences worldwide to Christopher Lee's definitive interpretation of Bram Stoker's immortal vampire. Opposite Peter Cushing's fearless Van Helsing, Lee brought a terrifying physicality and seductive menace to the role that would redefine the Count for generations. When Jonathan Harker arrives at a remote Transylvanian castle, he discovers that his mysterious host, Count Dracula, is a centuries-old vampire who feeds upon the blood of the living. As Dracula's reign of terror spreads across Europe, the determined Professor Van Helsing embarks on a desperate battle to destroy the Prince of Darkness before more innocent lives are claimed.

title: Royal Ballet and Opera: Tosca

locale.title: Royal Ballet and Opera: Tosca
locale.synopsis: Floria Tosca and Mario Cavaradossi live for each other and for their art. But when Cavaradossi helps an escaped prisoner, the lovers make a deadly enemy in the form of Baron Scarpia, Chief of Police. At the mercy of Scarpia’s twisted desires, Tosca is forced to make a horrific bargain: sleeping with the man she hates, in order to save the man she loves. Can she find a way out? Oliver Mears’s acclaimed production returns, setting Puccini’s operatic thriller in a contemporary, war-torn Rome. Daniel Oren conducts Aleksandra Kurzak, who returns to the title role, joined by Saimir Pirgu as Cavaradossi and Christopher Maltman as Baron Scarpia.

title: Royal Ballet and Opera: Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland

locale.title: Royal Ballet and Opera: Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland
locale.synopsis: At a garden party on a sunny afternoon, Alice is surprised to see her parents’ friend Lewis Carroll transform into a white rabbit. When she follows him down a rabbit hole, events become curiouser and curiouser…As Alice journeys through Wonderland, she encounters countless strange creatures. She’s swept off her feet by the charming Knave of Hearts, who’s on the run for stealing the tarts. Confusion piles upon confusion. Then Alice wakes with a start. Was it all a daydream? Christopher Wheeldon’s Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland burst onto the stage in 2011 in an explosion of colour, stage magic and inventive, sophisticated choreography. Joby Talbot’s score combines contemporary soundworlds with sweeping melodies that gesture to ballet scores of the 19th century. Bob Crowley’s wildly imaginative, eye-popping designs draw on everything from puppetry to projections to make Wonderland wonderfully real. The result shows The Royal Ballet at its best, bringing together world-class dance with enchanting family entertainment and ingenious music and design.

title: André Rieu's 2026 Christmas Concert: Let it snow!

locale.title: André Rieu's 2026 Christmas Concert: Let it snow!
locale.synopsis: This holiday season, celebrate the most wonderful time of the year on the big screen with André Rieu's 2026 Christmas Concert – Let It Snow. This heartwarming festive spectacular, filled with beloved Christmas classics, enchanting waltzes, and magical surprises, will leave you smiling long after the final encore. Joined by his world-famous Johann Strauss Orchestra, exceptional sopranos, and a powerful 120-voice male choir, André brings the spirit of Christmas to life in an unforgettable musical event. Overflowing with music, laughter, and holiday cheer, this concert is perfect for the whole family. Whether you're surrounded by snow or simply dreaming of it, experience the magic of Christmas on the big screen with those you love. Wrap up your year with Let It Snow – only in cinemas!

The King of the Waltz will once again transform his hometown into a sparkling winter fairy tale, filling the grand stage with festive decorations, twinkling lights, and a warm, joyous atmosphere. 

Together with his Johann Strauss Orchestra, world-class soloists, and special guests, André brings to life a heartwarming program of waltzes, beloved Christmas carols, and seasonal classics that will have you singing, swaying, and smiling from the very first note. It is an unforgettable experience full of laughter, emotion, and holiday magic. Families, friends, and music lovers from around the world gather to share in the beauty of music and the spirit of Christmas, creating memories that last a lifetime. Whether it is your first time or a cherished yearly visit, André Rieu's Christmas concerts promise a festive celebration unlike any other.

exhibitor.synopsis:

title: Barrel Children: The Families Windrush Left Behind + Live Q&A with Nadine White

locale.title: Barrel Children: The Families Windrush Left Behind + Live Q&A with Nadine White

exhibitor.synopsis:
Join us on Monday, 12 October, at Everyman King's Cross for a special screening of Barrel Children: The Families Windrush Left Behind, and stay after for a live Q&A with Nadine White - director and executive producer of the film, multi-award-winning journalist, and editor of Black Current News.

A stellar debut film from award-winning journalist Nadine White, Barrel Children: The Families Windrush Left Behind peels back the layered tales of Caribbean youngsters who grew up away from their parents before migrating to join them in Britain.

The story of Windrush has come into painfully sharp focus in recent years, but what is less well-known is the story of the children of these pioneers, whose parents left to rebuild Britain, and whom they only knew of through the ‘barrel' care packages sent back. 

These are the children’s stories of reconciliation and rediscovery within a new world.

title: Blue Velvet (40th Anniversary) | A Fictional Selves Special Screening

locale.title: Blue Velvet 35mm x Fictional Selves: 40th Anniversary Special Screening
locale.synopsis:
Join Everyman and Penguin Random House at Screen on the Green on Thursday 1st October 2026 for an extra special screening of Blue Velvet to celebrate the cult classic's 40th anniversary and the publication of Kyle MacLachlan's new memoir Fictional Selves.

Thanks to the carefully curated selection of characters he’d choose over the course of his remarkable career-in provocative films like Blue Velvet and Showgirls, as well as hit television shows like Sex and the City and Desperate Housewives- Kyle MacLachlan has become one of the most distinctive actors of his generation. In his first memoir Fictional Selves, MacLachlan offers an utterly original account of his offbeat journey in Hollywood and the projects that have shaped who he is today. Fictional Selves includes insights into behind-the-scenes stories from Kyle's most famous roles, and lessons learned along the way; his unwavering and long-lasting relationship with late director and close friend David Lynch; on and off-screen romantic entanglements; his own take on being a father; and much more.

In Blue Velvet, Kyle MacLachlan gave a career-defining performance as Jeffrey Beaumont, the clean-cut college student whose curiosity draws him into the dark underbelly of small-town America. His second collaboration with David Lynch, the film changed the trajectory of MacLachlan’s career and paved the way for one of cinema and television’s great creative partnerships.

title: Casino Royale (20th Anniversary)

locale.title: Casino Royale (20th Anniversary)
locale.synopsis: James Bond's first 007 mission takes him to Madagascar, where he is to spy on a terrorist Mollaka. Not everything goes as planned and Bond decides to investigate, independently of the MI6 agency, in order to track down the rest of the terrorist cell. Following a lead to the Bahamas, he encounters Dimitrios and his girlfriend, Solange. He learns that Dimitrios is involved with Le Chiffre, banker to the world's terrorist organizations. Secret Service intelligence reveals that Le Chiffre is planning to raise money in a high-stakes poker game in Montenegro at Le Casino Royale. MI6 assigns 007 to play against him, knowing that if Le Chiffre loses, it will destroy his organization. 'M' places Bond under the watchful eye of the beguiling Vesper Lynd. At first skeptical of what value Vesper can provide, Bond's interest in her deepens as they brave danger together--and even torture at the hands of Le Chiffre. In Montenegro, Bond allies himself with Matthis, MI6's local field agent, and Felix Leiter, who is representing the interests of the CIA. The marathon game proceeds with dirty tricks and violence, raising the stakes beyond blood money and reaching a terrifying climax.

rating.advisory: Contains one scene of torture and strong action violence

title: Che Dio perdona a tutti (God Forgives Everyone) UK Premiere + Live Q&A w/ PIF

locale.title: Che Dio perdona a tutti (God Forgives Everyone) UK Premiere + Q&A with PIF
locale.synopsis:
A promise kept.

Last year, when Pif joined us at Everyman for two sold-out screenings, we promised we would bring him back. This year, we are doing so on a date with a very special significance.

On 1 October 1996, while working at a London hostel, a young Pif became an Everyman member and a regular at Everyman Hampstead. He began dreaming of returning one day, not as a member of the audience, but as a director presenting his own film.

Exactly 30 years later, that dream comes full circle as Pif returns for the UK premiere of his latest film, …Che Dio perdona a tutti (God Forgives Everyone), followed by an on-stage conversation.

Pierfrancesco Diliberto, known as Pif, established himself as one of Italy’s most distinctive comedy filmmakers with his debut, The Mafia Kills Only in Summer. His work has a unique tone, combining tenderness and refreshing self-irony while bringing the intimate, political and social together with liberating directness.

In God Forgives Everyone, Pif plays Arturo, a successful real-estate agent whose love life is virtually non-existent and whose deepest emotional commitment is reserved for Sicilian pastries. But could an encounter with the enchanting Flora change his outlook on life? Blending romance, desserts and a curious exploration of Catholic faith, the film is also an affectionate homage to Pif’s beloved Palermo.

title: Collateral (35mm)

locale.title: Collateral (35mm)
locale.synopsis: Max has lived a mundane life as a cab driver for twelve years. The faces have come and gone from his rear-view mirror: people and places he's long since forgotten--until tonight. Vincent is a contract killer. When an offshore narco-trafficking cartel learns that they're about to be indicted by a federal grand jury, they mount an operation to identify and kill the key witness, and the last stage is tonight. It is on this very night that Vincent has arrived--and five bodies are supposed to fall. Circumstances cause Vincent to hijack Max' taxicab, and Max becomes collateral--an expendable person who's in the wrong place at the wrong time. Through the night, Vincent forces Max to drive him to each assigned destination. And as the L.A.P.D. and F.B.I. race to intercept them, Max and Vincent's survival become dependent on each other, in ways neither would have imagined.

exhibitor.synopsis:
Michael Mann returns to Everyman Screen on the Green from 25 September to 24 October. Join us for a season dedicated to five unforgettable works from one of modern cinema's most influential filmmakers.

This week, we're screening 'Collateral' in stunning 35mm. Tom Cruise delivers a chilling performance as Vincent, a contract killer who hijacks the cab of unsuspecting driver Max, played by Jamie Foxx, for a night of deadly assignments across Los Angeles. As the city lights blur past, Max is drawn into a tense battle of wits and survival. Stylish, suspenseful and visually groundbreaking, Collateral remains one of Michael Mann's most thrilling and acclaimed films.

title: De Gaulle: Résistance

locale.title: De Gaulle: Résistance
locale.synopsis: June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

title: Derek vs. Derek

locale.title: Derek vs. Derek
locale.synopsis:
On a country road in Devon,  intensive dairy farmer Derek Banbury is horrified at the “devastation” of  his neighbour’s once productive farm.  Dubbed  a “maverick rewilder” by the media,  Derek Gow is an unrepentant ex-sheep farmer hellbent on turning his land into an oasis for nature.  
Shot over three years the film charts the two Derek’s turbulent relationship, as tempers fray, wild animals run amok, and the land is radically transformed.

exhibitor.title: Do The Right Thing (1989)
exhibitor.synopsis:
Start your night right with a complimentary cocktail reception at 6PM. 
In collaboration with Murder Inc.

Everyman is proud to host Steven Soderbergh's A Man Under The Influence.

The series presents one film from each decade selected by Steven Soderbergh as a source of inspiration throughout his career. 

This week it's the 1980's; join us at Everyman at The Whiteley for Do The Right Thing (1989) - On the hottest day of the year on a street in the Bedford-Stuyvesant section of Brooklyn, everyone's hatred and bigotry smoulder and build until violence erupts. Fight the power!

Each screening is complete with a 63-minute reception featuring Singani 63 cocktails created with some of London's leading bars and inspired by the night's film, alongside a playlist curated by the filmmaker himself, and an exclusive recorded introduction from Soderbergh.

title: Doctor Who Day: The Satan Pit

locale.title: Doctor Who Day: The Satan Pit
locale.synopsis:
Celebrate Doctor Who Day with an exclusive big-screen event marking 20 years of the Tenth Doctor and Rose Tyler.
 
For the first time ever in cinemas, the acclaimed two-part adventure The Impossible Planet and The Satan Pit have been specially re-edited into a single movie-length presentation, created exclusively for theatrical audiences. Join the Doctor (David Tennant) and Rose (Billie Piper) as they travel to Sanctuary Base 6, a remote outpost perched on a planet orbiting a black hole. When an ancient force awakens beneath the surface, the crew find themselves trapped in a battle against an evil older than time itself.
 
This special Doctor Who Day screening also includes exclusive bonus material, featuring previously unseen content and a brand-new interview with a special guest, reflecting on the making of one of the most celebrated stories of the modern era – from encounters with the Ood to facing the terrifying Beast, alongside behind-the-scenes memories from the set.

title: Dracula (4K Restoration)

locale.title: Dracula 4k Restoration
locale.synopsis: A landmark in Gothic horror, Dracula cemented Hammer Films' reputation as the leading force in modern horror cinema and introduced audiences worldwide to Christopher Lee's definitive interpretation of Bram Stoker's immortal vampire. Opposite Peter Cushing's fearless Van Helsing, Lee brought a terrifying physicality and seductive menace to the role that would redefine the Count for generations. When Jonathan Harker arrives at a remote Transylvanian castle, he discovers that his mysterious host, Count Dracula, is a centuries-old vampire who feeds upon the blood of the living. As Dracula's reign of terror spreads across Europe, the determined Professor Van Helsing embarks on a desperate battle to destroy the Prince of Darkness before more innocent lives are claimed.
